meta.title: Notepad
meta.description: A per-workspace floating notepad in the session view with a dedicated Settings > Notepad tab: color themes that also tint the settings page, flat or adjustable frosted-glass surfaces, fonts, auto/manual saving, undo depth, AI prompt presets with a read-only preset preview plus Custom, button groups and hover threshold, card height, default geometry, and a button that stores the current panel position and size as the default. It adds plugin undo/redo (buttons sit left of copy-all) that never overrides textarea history and keeps typed text and composer inserts / replaces, while sends stay irreversible, foldable cards with batch select / archive / delete / copy, selection-aware AI rewriting that re-selects its output and re-measures the textarea, newest-first archives with auto-scroll that survive Backspace deletion of the last active card, a workspace dropdown limited to workspaces with an unarchived non-empty segment that opens a new session there, a right-aligned non-wrapping action bar whose overflow hides under the left selection label with Cancel selection leftmost, the same exit animation for Backspace deletion of an empty card, hover groups that collapse after mouse activation, a red hover state for batch delete, distinct new-session insert / send icons, image chips without filenames and with the remove button on the thumbnail corner, plus enter/exit animations and auto-save that no longer jumps the list to the top. The settings sidebar shows the plugin line icon, the header reset button is gone, and AI optimization raises the short-note output budget and retries an empty answer with the built-in prompt.
